title: Sing to the Lord a New Song

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:1 (ESV): "his praise in the assembly of the godly!"

questions.question: Let Israel be glad in his Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:2 (ESV): "let the children of Zion rejoice in their King!"

questions.question: Let them praise his name with dancing, making melody to him with tambourine and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:3 (ESV): "making melody to him with tambourine and lyre!"

questions.question: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:4 (ESV): "he adorns the humble with salvation."

questions.question: Let the godly exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:5 (ESV): "let them sing for joy on their beds."

questions.question: Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:6 (ESV): "and two-edged swords in their hands,"

questions.question: To execute vengeance on the nations and punishments on the what?
To bind their kings with chains and their nobles with fetters of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:8 (ESV): "and their nobles with fetters of iron,"

questions.question: To execute on them the judgment written! This is honor for all his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:9 (ESV): "This is honor for all his godly ones. Praise the Lord!"

questions.question: What accompanies the praise in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:3 (ESV): "Let them praise his name with dancing,"

questions.question: Who are the "godly ones" (Hasidim) in this Psalm?
questions.explanation: Refers to those loyal to God's covenant (saints).

questions.question: The combination of praise and swords signifies what?
questions.explanation: It depicts the people as God's army executing His judgment.

questions.question: What is the "judgment written"?
questions.explanation: Refers to the judgments God has ordained against the wicked nations.

questions.question: Why do they sing on their beds?
questions.explanation: Implies a state of security and joy even at night.

questions.question: Who is the "Maker" of Israel?
questions.explanation: Psalm 149:2 (ESV): "Let Israel be glad in his Maker;"

key_verse_text: Praise the Lord! Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of the godly!
